claims.text: The health check shows status degraded and db_writes failing.
The database read-only status check returns on.
The error psycopg.errors.ReadOnlySqlTransaction indicates it cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction.

steps.instruction: Check the database read-only status to confirm the problem.

steps.command: psql -h orders-db -U shop -c "alter system reset default_transaction_read_only" -c "select pg_reload_conf()"
steps.expect: ALTER SYSTEM and message indicating success or configuration reload

steps.instruction: Check the database read-only status again to confirm the fix.
